_provenance: Generated by shwoop-server/src/forwardTest.js (buildForwardTestSnapshot/buildCorrectionSnapshot) so every field name here is the backend's own, not one this repo guessed. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.

snapshots.warning: LIVE PAPER FORWARD TEST. These figures are measurements of paper order flow on mechanisms that failed their own research measurement. They are NOT a backtest result and must never be quoted as one, or compared against one as though the two were the same kind of number. Seven profit factors (2.71, 2.35, 4.08, 1.24, 1.93, 1.20, 1.05) were each quoted as a baseline here and each withdrawn; every withdrawal moved the number down.

since.reason: Market-order chase fix and the refinements shipped that weekend. Trades entered before this date were produced by a different configuration and are excluded from every figure in this record.

costModel.basis: round-trip rate applied to half the notional of each leg; modeled, not broker-billed

snapshots.exitMixDerivation: inferred from the recorded fill against stop/target/initialStop and the end-of-day flatten stamp; the journal does not record which bracket leg filled. Unclassifiable exits are counted as unclassified rather than guessed.
